desc:
Welcome to Motorcycle Bomb Tag 🏍️💣
Pass the bomb, dodge your rivals, and be the last rider standing!

❗ JOIN A LOW PING SERVER FOR BETTER HITBOXES

Grab a motorcycle and hit the streets in a high-speed game of hot potato.
🎮 Gamemodes only occur with 4 or more players in a server. [🔥] Streaks are unaffected.

💨 Features:

💣 Fast-paced bomb-tag rounds
🏍️ Unlock motorcycles as you progress
🎁 Open cases for rare bikes & big rewards
🏆 Earn badges for clutch plays & win streaks
